description: Elections Commission - Notified that the names of Political Parties recognized as recognized Political Parties for the Purpose of Section 7(4)(b) of the Parliamentary Elections Act No. 01 of 1981
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral processes by publishing the official list of recognized political parties for parliamentary elections under the Parliamentary Elections Act. It is issued by the Election Commission and falls under election administration matters, making it a clear example of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
